pairs.registryProposal: unpriced-span-accounting's last decision rule says 'a missing latency treated as zero merely makes a duration conservative'. That is true for summed per-span latency inside a fold whose wall-clock duration is measured separately, but read literally it licenses this context's single-figure duration ?? 0 rendered as '0 ms'. Scope the carve-out to per-span latency within an aggregate, and say that a run's or trace's own duration that was never measured stays null under never-present-absence-as-an-answer.
